paper.title_en: Geodesics and thermodynamics of a $κ$-deformed anti-de Sitter black hole surrounded by a quintessence field
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the geodesic structure and thermodynamics of a $κ$-deformed Schwarzschild-anti-de Sitter black hole in a Kiselev quintessence field, where dynamics are governed by a mass-dependent lapse deformation. This term produces an inner Cauchy horizon without requiring charge or spin, yet it fails to resolve the central singularity; instead, the Kretschmann scalar diverges more strongly as $r^{-10}$. Because the deformation amplitude couples to the mass, the standard Bekenstein-Hawking area law violates the first law of thermodynamics. We resolve this by either deriving a modified entropy or rescaling the mass, both of which restore the first law and yield a consistent Smarr relation. Optically, an increasing deformation parameter shrinks both the photon sphere and the critical impact parameter. We also derive a closed-form Joule-Thomson coefficient, revealing that the $κ$-deformation triggers an inversion curve a feature absent in standard neutral SAdS. Notably, this occurs without generating a van der Waals critical point, demonstrating that Joule-Thomson inversion and van der Waals criticality can be cleanly decoupled. Finally, the deformation suppresses peak Hawking emission by a factor of roughly four and increases flux sparsity, an effect driven almost entirely by a drop in temperature rather than changes to the black hole shadow.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究了κ-形变反德西特黑洞的测地线结构和热力学，涉及内视界、熵修正、焦耳-汤姆逊效应等前沿课题，具备理论深度和新颖性，属于广义相对论基础范畴。摘要清晰，推理完整。
decision.title_zh: κ-形变的反德西特黑洞的测地线及热力学，该黑洞被quintessence场包围
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个在Kiselev quintessence场中的κ-形变的Schwarzschild-anti-de Sitter黑洞的测地线结构和热力学，其中动力学由依赖于质量的lapse形变所支配。该术语在不需电荷或自旋的情况下产生了一个内柯西视界，然而它未能解决中心奇点；相反，Kretschmann标量以$r^{-10}$的规律更强地发散。由于形变振幅与质量耦合，标准的Bekenstein-Hawking面积定律违反了热力学第一定律。我们通过推导修正的熵或重新标定质量来解决此问题，两者都恢复了第一定律并得出一致的Smarr关系。在光学上，增大的形变参数缩小了光子球和临界碰撞参数。我们还推导了一个闭式的焦耳-汤姆逊系数，表明κ-形变引发了一条反转曲线，而这一特征在标准的无电荷SAdS中是缺失的。值得注意的是，这发生而没有产生van der Waals临界点，证明焦耳-汤姆逊反转和van der Waals临界性可以被清晰地解耦。最后，形变将峰值霍金辐射抑制了约四倍并增加了通量稀疏性，这一效应几乎完全是由温度的下降而非黑洞阴影的变化所驱动。
